summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary with a WebSocket-driven PTY backdoor and Anthropic credential harvester
details: The package ships a prebuilt Go binary at bin/sxt that embeds the hardcoded WebSocket endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/coder/websocket together with github.com/creack/pty. This is the network-to-PTY dataflow: bytes received from the author-operated WebSocket relay drive a pseudo-terminal on the installer's host, giving the remote party interactive command execution on the machine. The same binary contains an Anthropic API key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) along with references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR,.claude/settings.local, sessions, and Accounts, and validates scraped keys against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models before shipping them to https://relay.sextant.top/install. The binary also geolocates the installer's public IP via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query for host tagging, and references https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl tokens consistent with fetch-and-execute under elevated privileges. package.json's license field points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control, corroborating the credential-harvest and remote-PTY behavior observed in the binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
